output.sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date)::int AS order_year, ROUND(SUM(o.net_revenue), 2) AS net_revenue FROM marts.fct_orders o WHERE o.is_revenue GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
output.explanation: Shows net revenue for each calendar year of the order date. Only orders flagged as revenue (is_revenue = true) are counted, and values are rounded to 2 decimals.
